intent: Give evaluation batches their own Bounded Context, so eval keeps judging one Run and the batch owns running many trials, answering as the simulated user and reporting their pass rates.
observable_outcome: trial/batch is a reviewed Context with its own depguard rule and query ownership; it reaches run, testlab, trace and eval only through composition-root ports, and eval no longer holds any batch code.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The batch package is a reviewed Context whose only import of another Context is identity.
The batch report reads each Run's standing verdict through a port eval fills, not by querying evaluation rows.
Creating, advancing, answering, reporting and comparing batches behave as before the move.
The approval that makes the records reviewed is checkable outside the package.
